title: Review findings
description: Structured review output. Only actionable defects introduced by the reviewed change belong in findings.

title.description: Short, imperative summary prefixed with the priority, for example [P1].

body.description: Explain the triggering conditions, concrete impact, and evidence for the defect.

confidence.description: Confidence that the reported defect is real, not its severity.

path.description: Repository-relative path to the affected file, never an absolute host path.

line_start.description: First affected line, one-based and inclusive.

line_end.description: Last affected line, one-based and inclusive; must be at least line_start (a semantic check for consumers).

overall_verdict.description: incorrect when an actionable defect was found; correct when no actionable defect was found within the reviewed scope. Not a claim of exhaustive proof.
